origin.source_maturity: Spanda ADC rational recovery is documented DESIGN, not shipped implementation; new Python oracle implemented in this PR.

selected.arity: (x: exact rational, maximum_denominator: positive integer)->(closest exact rational, signed exact residual)
selected.behavior: For exact x and Q>=1, return reduced p/q with 1<=q<=Q minimizing exact |x-p/q| over all rationals. Break ties by smallest reduced denominator, then smallest signed numerator. Return residual r=x-p/q exactly; no float, no ADC uncertainty inference, no machine or physical T5 authority.

positives.result: p/q=-1; residual=+1/2 (tie chooses smaller signed numerator)

falsifiers: RATIONALIZE returns an arbitrary exact rational without enforcing Q, so it is not equivalent to a bounded recovery.
Returning a float or silently discarding signed residual violates exact representation.
Returning q>Q or any fraction with larger exact error violates best-approximation law.
Breaking Q=1 halfway ties differently from the declared denominator/numerator order.
ADC measurement uncertainty must not be inferred from the approximation residual.
